tips.text: Bank Aya before Epitaph Prime's Resurgence window opens; it never expires.
Buy extra relics for the Receiver; it is the Rare part and the bottleneck.
Buy her relics from the Market's Prime Resurgence tab to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine the Rare Receiver relics to Radiant and leave the Common relics Intact; radshare the Rares.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
